## How was it tested?
- [ ] Tests added or updated for new behavior
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass in `frontend/`

## Checklist
- [ ] Small enough to review in one sitting (under ~400 changed lines)
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:` ...)
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data in the code
- [ ] Nothing that could tell someone a meal is "safe"
- [ ] If AI wrote most of this, I understand it and it has tests
